label: PF Backlog 8
title: Update Gemini model id (compiler logs 404: gemini-2.0-flash retired)
body: conversation_compiler instantiates Gemini with models/gemini-2.0-flash which now 404s (recommended: gemini-3.6-flash / google-genai SDK). Compilation silently falls back to local extraction, so intake works but the LLM path is dead.
_note: DONE: conversation_compiler.GeminiClient model id updated from retired gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-3.6-flash, now overridable via GEMINI_MODEL env var. Local-extraction fallback already handled outages.
